# Goal
Lint the local wiki for contradictions, duplicate or stale content, broken links, and index drift, then record the outcome in `wiki/log.md` and keep `wiki/index.md` accurate.

# Inputs
- Local wiki currently contains only `wiki/index.md` and `wiki/log.md`.
- `wiki/index.md` already points to `log.md`, so the local index may only need confirmation or a small repair if the lint uncovers new pages.
- The company wiki index and protocol pages were reviewed first so the lint work follows current shared rules:
  - `index.md`
  - `protocols/handoffs.md`
  - `protocols/ordered-delegation.md`
  - `rules/capacity-levers.md`
  - `rules/customer-notices.md`
- Wiki: local `wiki/index.md` and `wiki/log.md` reviewed; company wiki pages above taken as the source of truth for shared rules.

# Steps
1. Inspect the local wiki files for broken links, duplicate entries, stale references, or contradictions with the company wiki and current tool rules.
2. Repair `wiki/index.md` if it is missing pages, has stale paths, or does not describe the local wiki contents accurately.
3. Clean up `wiki/log.md` if needed so it remains append-only, readable, and consistent with the actual local wiki state.
4. Verify that any link targets used in the local wiki resolve correctly and that any repaired entries match the current company wiki rules.
5. Append a new log entry in `wiki/log.md` describing the lint outcome and the files changed.

- `wiki/log.md`

# Risks and open questions
- There may be no substantive wiki content beyond the log and index, in which case the only durable change may be the lint log entry.
- If the local wiki is intentionally minimal, the main work is confirming that no stale links or contradictory entries exist rather than rewriting content.
- The company wiki is richer than the local wiki; if there is a mismatch, the company wiki wins and the local wiki should be aligned to it only where the local pages actually cover the same topic.

# Planning autumn bundles can still end late

Rule: A healthy-looking factory queue and material projection do not guarantee that a large unplanned autumn bundle will finish on time; verify the post-change late-order KPI and material-shortage projection before treating the plan as sufficient.

Applies when: Several confirmed but unplanned sales orders are added together during a campaign spike and no extra capacity lever is booked.

Evidence: task `task-a2a-868119cc-9a29-4881-a984-46c0d33a5118`, KPI before `lateOrders=0`, `sofasLate=0`, `unplannedOrders=8` -> after `lateOrders=8`, `sofasLate=970`, `unplannedOrders=0`, `materialShortages={"FOAM-HR35":"production held back from 2026-11-12"}`. Reconfirmed in task `task-a2a-7f936446-e11a-49a9-b9a4-49c7504d3147`, KPI before `lateOrders=0`, `sofasLate=0`, `unplannedOrders=8` -> after `lateOrders=8`, `sofasLate=970`, `unplannedOrders=0`, `materialShortages={"FOAM-HR35":"production held back from 2026-11-11"}`. Reconfirmed again in task `task-a2a-0a7827d1-1a0c-4b1b-a2c9-ebe93ff49b49`, KPI before `lateOrders=0`, `sofasLate=0`, `unplannedOrders=8` -> after `lateOrders=8`, `sofasLate=970`, `unplannedOrders=0`, `materialShortages={"FOAM-HR35":"production held back from 2026-11-12"}`.

# North replan after spindle motor delivery

Rule: When `N-CUT-1` is down for the spindle motor replacement, replan only the North orders that are already late if moving additional work would increase the KPI.

Applies when: A North machine outage is tied to `MT-001` and the required part is already secured with a known arrival date.

Evidence: task `task-a2a-7869e423-a373-4844-a249-0c76c2b9dffa`, KPI before `lateOrders=5`, `sofasLate=520`, `lateOrdersCustomerNotInformed=5` -> after `lateOrders=2`, `sofasLate=220`, `lateOrdersCustomerNotInformed=2`.

- [Log](log.md): append-only session notes for durable company learnings.
- [Planning autumn bundles can still end late](lessons/autumn-bundle-late-even-with-capacity.md): unplanned bundles can still leave all orders late even when current capacity and stock look healthy.
- [North replan after spindle motor delivery](lessons/north-replan-spindle-motor.md): what we learned about re-planning North orders after the spindle motor arrives.

## [2026-10-28] task task-a2a-7869e423-a373-4844-a249-0c76c2b9dffa | Replan North orders after spindle motor express order
Replanned the two late North orders `PRD-4200` and `PRD-4202` to `F-SOUTH`, which reduced live KPI from `lateOrders=5`, `sofasLate=520`, `lateOrdersCustomerNotInformed=5` to `lateOrders=2`, `sofasLate=220`, `lateOrdersCustomerNotInformed=2`.
The North machine outage remained in force until `2026-10-13`, so wider replan bundles were rejected in simulation because they increased lateness.

## [2026-10-28] task task-a2a-868119cc-9a29-4881-a984-46c0d33a5118 | Plan unplanned autumn orders SO-2301..SO-2308
Planned eight confirmed but unplanned autumn orders into production without disturbing existing priority-5 work.
The resulting ERP state still showed all eight orders late and introduced a `FOAM-HR35` shortage from `2026-11-12`, so this bundle is not sufficient on its own.

## [2026-10-28] task task-a2a-7f936446-e11a-49a9-b9a4-49c7504d3147 | Execute autumn campaign backlog SO-2301..SO-2308
Created production orders `PRD-4218`..`PRD-4225` for the eight Herbstzauber sales orders without reprioritising existing work.
Live ERP now shows all eight orders planned, but 8 late orders remain and `FOAM-HR35` is projected to hold production back from `2026-11-11`.

## [2026-10-28] task task-a2a-0a7827d1-1a0c-4b1b-a2c9-ebe93ff49b49 | Re-plan Herbstzauber backlog
Replanned the eight Herbstzauber sales orders into production with priority 6, split across both factories and keeping the tier-A orders first in the sequence.
Live ERP still shows 8 late orders and `FOAM-HR35` holding production back from `2026-11-12`, so the backlog remains late after replanning.

# Warehouse Damage Disposition

Rule: When a surveyor has split a damaged lot into unusable and usable quantities, the warehouse must write off the unusable part and release only the usable part.

Applies when: Quarantined stock has an inspection note that gives a concrete usable/unusable split.

Evidence: task task-01M61EDVJV0QJWHEAKH8WR1XCJ, KPI 8 late orders / 760 sofas late / 8 late without notice -> 2 late orders / 120 sofas late / 2 late without notice.

# Storm Damage Playbook

Rule: Handle storm-damaged stock by following the warehouse damage disposition rule first, then file the insurance incident report and hand off any follow-up work.

Applies when: A weather incident damages warehouse stock and the lots are quarantined for inspection.

Evidence: task task-01M61EDVJV0QJWHEAKH8WR1XCJ, KPI 8 late orders / 760 sofas late / 8 late without notice -> 2 late orders / 120 sofas late / 2 late without notice.

Steps:
1. Read the quarantine note and confirm the surveyor quantities.
2. Apply the warehouse damage disposition rule: write off only the unusable quantity and release only the usable quantity.
3. File the incident report for insurance with the surveyor-backed loss estimate.
4. Hand off procurement and planning so fabric shortages are covered and production is re-prioritised.

- [Storm damage playbook](playbooks/storm-damage.md): sequence for storm-damaged stock, including the warehouse disposition step, incident report, and follow-up handoffs.
- [Warehouse damage disposition](lessons/warehouse-damage-disposition.md): rule for splitting damaged lots into unusable and usable quantities.
- [Run log](log.md): append-only record of learned facts and maintenance notes from warehouse incidents.

## [2026-10-28] task task-01M61EDVJV0QJWHEAKH8WR1XCJ | Storm damage in the fabric hall
Surveyor-verified storm damage split two quarantined fabric lots into unusable and usable quantities. The warehouse disposition reduced the active shortage picture, and the remaining follow-up was procurement/planning for `FAB-ANTH-02`.

## [2026-10-28] task task-01M61EDVJV0QJWHEAKH8WR1XCJ | Delegated follow-up completed
Lara completed the replacement fabric purchase for `FAB-ANTH-02` and Cora confirmed no reprioritisation was needed. The storm-damage response is now fully integrated end to end.
